en: A black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a sloping street lined with traditional multi‑story houses and trees. Two people walk down the unpaved road toward the town center. In the background are more buildings with gabled roofs and a larger institutional-looking building with a small tower or cupola. Rolling hills and a few distant structures are visible beyond the town. The title text printed at the top right reads "Sebnitz i. Sa. Bergstraße," indicating the name of the town and the street.
